summary: Dolphin's current public API page offers $10 in Dolphin API credit with coupon code API10. Redemption happens in app.dphn.ai: connect a wallet, verify it by signing a message (free, no transaction), authorize with the Telegram bot, then enter API10 under Redeem Code. The API is OpenAI-compatible (base URL https://lighthouse.dphn.ai/run/text-v/v1) and currently serves DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at $0.01/M input and $0.07/M output tokens. Copy checked 2026-10-14: no account redemption was tested, no enrollment deadline is published, and the historical API30 coupon's independent validity remains unknown.
claim_steps: Open app.dphn.ai and connect your wallet
Click Verify Wallet and sign the message (free, no transaction)
Click Open Telegram and press Start in the bot
Enter API10 in Redeem Code and click Redeem
In API Keys, click Create Key and send your first request
